access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3481) from the museum's open-access image. A white cotton shirtwaist: a tall standing collar, a ruffled front, sleeves full above and gathered into narrow buttoned cuffs at the wrist, the body pouched forward over a tied waist. A real garment, American, in colour (white), on a form.
note: A reference picture for the 1904 parlor maid's shirtwaist, Christine Nelson of the Glessner household (data/humans/recipes/errand_1904.json).
what_it_supplies: the white of a cotton shirtwaist of about 1900, its tall collar, full sleeves, narrow cuffs and pouched front
what_it_does_not_supply: how it was worn by a working woman in the street
